preprocess_image_processor: preprocess images and COCO annotations for GroundingDino model input with padding and normalization
post_process_object_detection: post process GroundingDino model outputs into final bounding boxes with confidence scores and class labels
prepare_coco_detection_annotation: prepare COCO detection annotations by converting bounding boxes and categories to GroundingDino target format
convert_coco_poly_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentation annotations to binary masks for object detection tasks
resize_annotation: resize annotations including bounding boxes, masks, and area to match resized image dimensions
